# Sphero

> > Sphero is a leading provider of coding robots and STEM/STEAM kits designed to teach computer science, AI literacy, and engineering skills to K-12 students through hands-on, programmable robotics.

Sphero offers a comprehensive range of educational robotics products including coding robots (Mini, BOLT+, indi), programmable cars (RVR+), and modular engineering kits (Blueprint, littleBits). The company provides extensive educator resources, professional development, and curriculum aligned to national standards.

## Key Topics

- Coding Robots
- STEM Education

## Product Collections

- [All Sphero Products](https://sphero.com/collections/all): Main product catalog showcasing all Sphero coding robots and STEM kits
- [Sphero indi](https://sphero.com/collections/indi): Screenless educational robot designed for early learners
- [Sphero Mini](https://sphero.com/collections/mini): Coding robot balls and accessories for introductory programming
- [Sphero BOLT+](https://sphero.com/collections/bolt-plus): Advanced round coding robots with LED displays for kids and teens
- [Sphero RVR+](https://sphero.com/collections/rvr): Programmable robotic cars with modular capabilities
- [Blueprint Engineering Kits](https://sphero.com/collections/blueprint): Modular STEM engineering kits for middle and high school
- [Blueprint Snap Kits](https://sphero.com/collections/blueprint-snap): STEM engineering kits designed for elementary and middle school
- [littleBits STEM Kits](https://sphero.com/collections/littlebits): Electronic building block kits for hands-on learning

## Educator Resources & Professional Development

- [Educator Hub](https://sphero.com/pages/educators): Central hub for educator resources, curriculum, lesson plans, and professional development
- [Professional Development](https://sphero.com/collections/professional-development): Professional development courses and training for educators including self-guided, on-site, and virtual options
- [Standards Alignment](https://sphero.com/pages/standards-alignment): Curriculum guide aligned to national and state educational standards for STEAM activities and computer science
- [Free Webinars](https://sphero.com/pages/webinars): Free webinars and teacher resources on STEM topics and robotics education
- [Sphero Symposiums](https://sphero.com/pages/symposiums): Free STEM symposiums and workshops for PK-12 educators

## Tools & Downloads

- [Sphero Apps](https://sphero.com/pages/apps): Download programming apps and software tools for Mini, BOLT+, littleBits, and RVR+

## Optional

- [STEM & Computer Science Funding](https://sphero.com/pages/stem-computer-science-funding): Grant resources and funding guides for STEM and robotics programs
